purpose: What a device instance id is derived from, and what may never be derived from. The rule lived in four implementations and in no vector: Hub, the firmware, this SDK and a phone each read it from prose and each had to get it right alone.
derived_from: the SubjectPublicKeyInfo DER of the device's operational key

must_refuse.why: The same key as spki_der_base64url, written without its SPKI header. Hashing it yields a well-formed device instance id that no Authority has a record of, so nothing fails where the mistake is: the device is refused later as an identity nobody recognises. The natural PSA idiom (psa_export_public_key) and Android's raw EC point both hand back this encoding.
An SPKI prefix with no point. Three tests in this repository named their device by hashing exactly this, which is how a stub became an identity.
